method: one warmup excluded; median of five runs; same Arrow IPC file and fresh DuckDB runtime for each JDBC and Appender import; cardinality checked after timed materialization

environment.cpu: 13th Gen Intel Core i7-1355U; WSL reports 8 logical CPUs

limitations: Local diagnostic only. This compares two row-wise import paths, not zero-copy/vectorized Arrow C Data or CTAS. No process RSS, spill, confidence intervals, runner isolation, 100k/capacity-sized cases, or release threshold. The apparent speedup needs independent-runner reproduction; do not use as a release claim.
